source_file: SUMMARY_PGIM India Short Duration Fund (Earlier known as PGIM India Short Maturity Fund).pdf

data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: To achieve long term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in equity and equity related instruments of small cap companies. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved. The Scheme does not guarantee/ indicate any returns.
data.asset_allocation:
Equity & Equity Related Instruments of Small Cap Companies - Min 65% and Max 100%
Equity & Equity Related Instruments of other companies- Min 0% and Max 35%
Debt and Money Market instruments (including cash and cash equivalents), Liquid and Debt Schemes of Mutual Fund - Min 0% and Max 35%
Units issued by InVITs and REITs - Min 0% and Max 10%
data.exit_load: For Exits within 90 days from date of allotment of units: 0.50%; For Exits beyond 90 days from date of allotment of units: NIL.
